description: This file is a shell script that defines a suite of automated tests for a JSON writer utility. It uses test-lib.sh for testing framework functions, runs the json-writer tool with various inputs, and verifies JSON outputs via comparisons. It also includes a Perl JSON parser test for validation.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description and a command sequence.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output to expected output files.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Runs the specified tool with given arguments.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
